answer: Spectral analysis at the dawn: each identity's score equals its second-eigenvector centrality, so clusters of self-dealing accounts collapse toward zero. The harbor of honest edges dominates the graph spectrum. A knoll of fake links barely shifts eigenvalues. To fake one credible identity, an attacker must buy roughly 30 organic attestations at ~$50 each, so break-even sits near $1,500 per sybil.
